'''Marvasa's Marauders''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group based in the [[Cyrillian Protectorate/Legends|Cyrillian Protectorate]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] was once a member, receiving his distinctive facial [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] from the group.
